{{Quote|Get a scanning crew in here on the double! I want every part of this ship checked!|Captain Khurgee to his [[stormtrooper]] subordinates|<ref name="ANH" />}}
'''Edmos Khurgee''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire]] as a [[security officer]] with the [[military rank]] of [[captain]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. During the war he served on board the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], and was in charge of having the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' searched when it was brought on board by the [[Space station|station's]] [[tractor beam]]s.

==Biography==
{{Quote|There's no one on board, sir. According to the log, the crew abandoned ship right after takeoff.|Khurgee reporting to Darth Vader|<ref name="ANH" />}}
A [[Gender|male]] [[human]], Edmos Khurgee came to serve as an [[Imperial officer|officer]] in the [[Imperial Military|military]] of the [[Galactic Empire]],<ref name="ANH" /> a [[Fascism|fascist]] regime led by [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]].<ref name="SWP">''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]''</ref> As such, he participated in the [[Galactic Civil War]], in which the Empire fought the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]],<ref name="ANH" /> a resistance movement that sought to overthrow Palpatine and restore [[democracy]] to [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Alliance DB">{{Databank|rebel-alliance|Rebel Alliance}}</ref>

[[File:COMPNOR_Recruitment-SW_Propaganda.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Edmos Khurgee (right) and Dasita Lyros (left) on a recruitment poster]]
At some point, Khurgee served as the model for the male officer appearing on the [[propaganda]] [[Painting|poster]] ''[[COMPNOR Recruitment]],'' which incited citizens to join the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] (or COMPNOR for short), an agency responsible for the propagation of the Empire's [[New Order|underlying ideology]]. While it hinted that the captain might have enjoyed a privileged relationship with COMPNOR officials, as cronyism was the norm at the time, it also started unfounded rumors that Khurgee and the [[artist]], [[Dasita Lyros]], were lovers.<ref name="SWP" />

In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="ANH Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> Khurgee<ref name="ANH" /> was a [[security officer]]<ref name="Rise of the Rebellion">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Rise of the Rebellion and the Battle of Yavin}}</ref> with the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[captain]], and he was stationed aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]], the Empire's brand new sphere-shaped [[Realspace|deep space]] mobile [[battle station]]. One [[Standard day|day]], the Death Star's [[tractor beam]]s captured a [[Corellia]]n [[freighter]] entering the area of space containing the [[Alderaanian Graveyard|remains]] of the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]], which had just been [[Destruction of Alderaan|destroyed]] by the battle station. When the captured craft, the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', was deposited in [[Docking Bay 327]], Captain Khurgee led the initial inspection in person, searching the premises and checking the ship's log. Because there did not seem to be anyone on board, and because the log recorded that the crew abandoned ship immediately after takeoff, the captain concluded the ''Falcon'' might have been merely a decoy. Khurgee then reported his observations and conclusions to [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], the Emperor's black-[[armor]]ed enforcer, who nevertheless ordered him to send a scanning crew aboard to perform a more thorough search.<ref name="ANH" />

==Equipment==
While on duty aboard the Death Star, Edmos wore a gray [[Imperial military uniforms|Imperial officer's uniform]]<ref name="ANH" /> made of [[gaberwool]],<ref name="ROUVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> including a [[Hat|cap]] with an [[Officer's disk|identity disk]]. He wore two [[code cylinder]]s and a [[rank insignia plaque]] on his breast. The plaque showed a single row of six amber squares.<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Khurgee first appeared in {{film|IV}} in [[1977]].<ref name="ANH" /> Although not credited in the film, he was played by [[Wikipedia:Chicago|Chicago]] native and actor [[Christopher Muncke]].<ref name="A Munck's Tale">{{WebCite|url=http://www.wattographs.com/Recollections/RecollectionsChrisMuncke.aspx|text=Living a Life Forcefully: A Muncke's Tale|author=Frank D. Rich|work=Wattographs|archivedate=20190116180538}}</ref> The first name "Edmos" was created by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] for the [[2016]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy]]''.<ref name="SWP" />

Muncke's scenes were shot in one day at [[Elstree Studios]] near [[Wikipedia:London|London]], [[Wikipedia:England|England]]. The actor recalled that, while he expected the make up crew to cut his hair because he was going to play a military officer, they told him they only needed to trim it a little, because the movie takes place in a totally different time altogether.<ref name="A Munck's Tale" />
